text:
maria_g: Heads-up — started getting reports that Contoso users lose RBAC entitlements (teams/org roles) right after SSO. Seemed to happen only when they hit the ingress with session-affinity enabled. Rolled the affinity change back and one user recovered. Anyone seen this pattern?

ashok: Hmm — are entitlements missing in the SCIM provisioning logs or are they present and then stripped on the app side?

maria_g: Quick check: SCIM webhook shows the create/update payload includes groups, but the downstream audit shows an empty entitlements array for the session that followed SSO. Attached snippet: 
```
scim_event: { user: "jdoe@contoso.com", groups: ["engineers","beta"], mutation: "PATCH" }
app_audit: { user: "jdoe@contoso.com", entitlements: [] }
```

sarah: Two poss possibilities: 1) OIDC session token is being reissued without the latest claims (cache/kvcache issue) 2) KMS key used to sign/verify session cookies was rotated and some nodes have old key cached. Do we see any KMS errors in the auth-service logs?

kevin: Also check the ALB/NLB sticky config. If different backends see different key material (stale local keystore) and session affinity routes to a node that can't decrypt/verify, it might drop claims. What did we change earlier today?

maria_g: We enabled "ip_session_affinity" behind the LB to reduce bursty reauths at 09:10. IdP deploy happened ~09:05 (idp-bot msg), and a KMS rotation script ran at 09:00 (ops). Not sure order matters but looks suspicious.

idp-bot: deploy idp-service v2.13 completed at 09:05 by jenkins-ci — release notes: "opt-in session-affinity header support; local key cache TTL lowered to 5m" :gear: 

ashok: Can you paste a raw request/response for a failing login? need cookie headers, signed token (redact token but include kid), and the audit line.

maria_g: Pasted anonymized headers: 
```
GET /callback HTTP/1.1
Host: app.contoso.redwood.ai
X-Forwarded-For: 52.12.34.56
Cookie: idp_sid=***; AWSELB=abc123;
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED (kid: rsa-kms-2024-09)
```
app audit: `auth:verify: success (sub=jdoe@contoso.com, kid=rsa-kms-2024-08) -> mapped_roles: []`

kevin: Aha — kid mismatch. The token claims were verified with a different KID (2024-08) than the current token's kid (2024-09). That explains why roles didn't propagate. Nodes verifying with older key will accept token but the mapping step depends on fetched user info from SCIM which might be rate-limited or short-circuited if verification context changes.

sarah: We should look for KMS Decrypt/Sign errors and key-cache TTL settings on idp-service. If the local key cache TTL was lowered, nodes might temporarily refer to older cache if the rotation flows are in-flight. Check kms auditor: `aws:kms:Decrypt failed` logs?

maria_g: I see these in auth logs right after 09:00: `WARN: kms client error: AccessDeniedException on key arn:aws:kms:...:key/old-key-id` then repeats a few times, then `INFO: rotating to key rsa-kms-2024-09`. Also one backend returned 500 to SCIM callback: `POST /scim/v2/Events -> 500 (timeout)`

ashok: That maps: KMS rotation + a transient SCIM 500 + session-affinity change = race. Some sessions were created before rotation and routed to nodes that couldn't decrypt new signatures, causing the app to treat them as unauthenticated or with empty claims.

kevin: Mitigation: 1) Re-enable non-affinity routing to let load balance spread and pick nodes with updated key caches (short term). 2) Roll forward KMS key policy to ensure all nodes can decrypt (ops). 3) Replay pending SCIM events for impacted users.

maria_g: Oncall — can you run the replay for these user IDs and confirm SCIM PATCH succeeds? I'll open a scoped incident for Contoso.

oncall: Starting SCIM replay for affected tenant contoso (IDs: [redacted]). Will post results.

kevin: Also add a healthcheck: if token.kid != node.keyset.active_kid -> force keyset refresh before mapping roles. Save us a class of races.

sarah: +1 to keyset refresh and add a KMS audit alert for AccessDeniedException spikes during rotation window. We should also avoid lowering local key cache TTL until rotation flows are rock-solid.

maria_g: Plan: (1) replay SCIM for impacted users (oncall) (2) revert ip_session_affinity change for 1h (kevin) (3) ops to confirm KMS policy and replay/ensure all nodes have rsa-kms-2024-09 (sarah) (4) add quick code guard to refresh keyset on kid mismatch (ashok). I'll file a postmortem template once we confirm scope.

ashok: I can take the guard change and a small unit test for kid mismatch. Assigning to me.

idp-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-2873 "Contoso SSO entitlements missing during KMS rotation" assigned to eng-security, priority P2.

maria_g: Thanks — I'll update Contoso AM and sync with support. If anyone sees new 500s or new AccessDenied in kms logs, ping here. :eyes:
